title: Electrical Stimulation of the Dentate Nucleus for Upper Extremity Hemiparesis Due to Ischemic Stroke
brief_summary: This clinical trial will evaluate if Deep Brain Stimulation (DBS) is safe for the treatment of stroke and will help understand if DBS improves motor recovery for patients who continue to have significant impairment.
raw_criteria:
Key Inclusion Criteria:

* One-time stroke that occurred 1-3 years ago (i.e. index stroke 12-36 months)
* Stroke due to a blocked blood vessel (i.e. unilateral MCA stroke)
* Moderate to severe weakness in one arm (i.e. unilateral upper-extremity hemiparesis)

Key Exclusion Criteria:

* Seizures since time of stroke (i.e. seizures or seizure disorder)
* Unable to have an MRI (i.e. contraindicated for MRI)
